description:
Cast Replication Technique by paying {4}{U}, creating a token copy of Dark Depths.
Activate Mishra's Groundbreaker by tapping and sacrificing it, causing Dark Depths to become a creature.
Activate Vampire Hexmage by sacrificing it, removing all counters from the Dark Depths token.
The Dark Depths token triggers, causing you to not sacrifice it due to The Master.
Step 4 repeats infinitely, creating a mandatory infinite loop, causing the game to end in a draw.
